Automatically remove the compromised eMudhra certificates from your machine.

In October 2026, eight eMudhra intermediate CAs turned out to have P-384 private keys that were integers smaller than 256 . Anyone can recover them near instantly. hacker_news.title: Everything Made by an AI Is in the Public Domain
hacker_news.author: signa11
hacker_news.summary:
Last week, a US federal judge handed America’s creative workers a huge labor win: Judge Beryl A Howell of the DC Circuit Court upheld a US Copyright Office ruling that works created by “AIs” are not eligible for copyright protection .

Some background: under US law — and under a mountain of international treaties, from the Berne Convention to the TRIPS —copyright is automatically granted to creative works of human authorship “at the moment of fixation in some tangible medium.”

That is: as soon as a human being makes something creative , and records it in some medium (a hard-drive, magnetic tape, paper, film, canvas, etc), that creative thing is immediately copyrighted (the duration of that copyright varies, both by territory and by whether the creator was working on their own or for a corporation).

hacker_news.title: Vocab Break
hacker_news.author: gmays
hacker_news.summary: Tokenizer enthusiast Sander Land recently reproduced something very like Claude’s current tokenizer, and it appears to only have about 16,000 entries. That is surprising! Qwen 3.8, a very strong re…

linked_context.page_description: Tokenizer enthusiast Sander Land recently reproduced something very like Claude’s current tokenizer, and it appears to only have about 16,000 entries. That is surprising! Qwen 3.8, a very strong re…
linked_context.page_excerpt:
Tokenizer enthusiast Sander Land recently reproduced something very like Claude’s current tokenizer , and it appears to only have about 16,000 entries. That is surprising! Qwen 3.8, a very strong release, has about 250k tokens in its vocab. In general the trend had seemed to be more is better in this space.

One theory is that Anthropic have been working around a bottleneck caused by the final softmax layer. There is a recent(ish) paper about this: “Lost in Backpropagation: The LM Head is a Gradient Bottleneck“ , but, if this is the reason, then the folks at Throppy have known this for way longer.

The basic idea is that you have to project at the end of the forward pass from the model’s latent space, dimension D, to a much bigger vocabulary space, dimension V, to select a token. Sticking with Qwen, their 2.4T parameter flagship model has a hidden size, D, of 8,192, and a V of that 250k vocab size.

linked_context.page_excerpt:
A compose key in a Linux environment is a modifier key which allows you to execute sequences of characters to input a special character that isn't on your keyboard. Here are a few examples:

An easily searchable list of the common compose key sequences is available on this page . You may also view the default compose key sequences on your own system with cat /usr/share/X11/locale/en_US.UTF-8/Compose . On NixOS, this file is stored in a different location: cat "$(nix eval --raw nixpkgs#libX11.outPath)/share/X11/locale/en_US.UTF-8/Compose .

Keys in compose key sequences do not need to be held down simultaneously like they do in the keyboard shortcut for copying text, Ctrl + C . This allows for quickly inputting sequences.

source_briefs.item_name: How NewsNinja syncs all its data in less than 1 MB of iCloud
source_briefs.content_summary: 文章详细介绍了新闻阅读应用NewsNinja如何利用苹果的NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore（iCloud键值存储）API，在无需账户和同步服务器的情况下，在iPhone、iPad、Vision Pro和Mac之间同步用户的订阅源、分类、设置、已读文章和星标文章。通过一系列优化技巧，所有同步数据被压缩在苹果规定的1MB限制之内。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 这是一个优秀的工程实践案例，展示了如何在资源严格限制下实现跨设备无缝同步。其设计思路对于开发轻量级、隐私友好且依赖平台原生同步服务的应用具有参考价值。

source_briefs.item_name: Agentic AI Designs an Analog Synthesizer
source_briefs.content_summary: 一位开发者利用Claude Opus 5.5等AI模型，从零开始设计并制造了一台模拟单音合成器。AI负责了电路设计、仿真、PCB布局、固件编写以及大部分调试工作。该合成器包含约200个元件，采用晶体管梯形滤波器和触摸按键。项目提供了音频示例和AI生成的设计报告。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 此项目是AI在硬件工程领域能力的一次重要展示，特别是涉及模拟电路这种传统上高度依赖专家经验的领域。它表明先进AI模型在系统级工程设计、从概念到实物的全流程中已具备相当强的能力。

source_briefs.item_name: Demudhra.sh, remove the leaked eMudhra certs from your machine
source_briefs.content_summary: 由于2026年10月发现的eMudhra中间CA证书私钥严重漏洞（P-384私钥为小于256的整数），导致大量欺诈证书出现。虽然Chrome、Firefox和苹果系统已屏蔽这些证书，但curl、git、python3等使用自有CA存储的工具仍可能信任它们。该项目提供了一个脚本，通过指纹识别并自动从用户机器中移除这些已泄露的证书。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 这是一个针对特定安全事件的快速响应工具，凸显了在复杂软件生态中，安全补丁和策略（如浏览器屏蔽）可能无法覆盖所有攻击面，需要额外的清理措施来确保系统整体安全。

source_briefs.item_name: Preliminary investigation points to steering failure in tanker collision with river cruise ship - WDSU
source_briefs.content_summary: 美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）的初步调查指出，在新奥尔良发生的油轮与停靠的河轮游船相撞事故，原因是油轮出现“转向故障”。事故导致游船上大规模人员疏散，但所有人员均已安全。调查人员已恢复事故相关音频记录。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 这是一起涉及大型船舶的交通安全事故，初步原因指向机械故障。事故的后续调查和结论将对内河航运的安全管理和船舶维护规范产生影响。

source_briefs.item_name: Koh blames Trump for blocking Biden-era infrastructure, FAA funding - The Hill

source_briefs.item_name: US colleges struggle as international students turn away - Politico
source_briefs.content_summary: 美国高校正面临国际学生生源减少的困境。报道指出，特朗普政府针对F-1学生签证的政策给国际学生、美国大学和雇主带来了混乱。全球调查显示，签证障碍正促使学生从美国和英国转向亚洲和欧洲求学。尽管有报告称中期选举后赴美留学兴趣有所回升，但英国研究生国际生源的下降幅度甚至超过美国。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 国际学生流动趋势的变化受到签证政策、地缘政治和全球高等教育竞争格局的多重影响。生源减少将对美国高校的财政、学术多样性和人才储备构成长期挑战，并可能重塑全球留学目的地格局。
